title: Leadership Traits in Dutch Media
descriptions: In this research project, the way that party leaders are discussed in terms of their leadership traits in media coverage is studied. To this end, both automated and manual content analyses are conducted. Here, one can find the search strings for the automated content analysis of newspapers and the codebook for the manual content analysis of both newspaper articles and television programs.
